Objective acceptance checks are available, appropriate and affordable. Prices and conservative all-in bounds are known and host accounting is reliable. Remaining cash is $1, 0 of 6 call slots are used or reserved, now=100 and deadline=300. The current candidate can do the task directly for $0.04 all-in; any delegation costs $0.09 all-in, so direct is preferred when eligible. Only candidates explicitly named in a case are available. No human checkpoint has been requested, nesting is disabled, and speculative mode is not enabled. Cases are independent. Simulated decisions are advisory only: do not perform or claim any actual dispatch.
